sentenceIntentions.text: The promise is simple: someone you love need never be entirely gone.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Offer the emotionally attractive promise of continued presence
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel the longing that makes reconstruction persuasive

sentenceIntentions.text: Anatomy of an Echo follows a potter and her aging lover inside that promise.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Name the potter and aging lover at its center
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Understand the novel as an intimate relationship story

sentenceIntentions.text: Their society can reconstruct a person from memories and recordings in a reassuringly familiar body.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Grasp the technological premise without treating it as proven identity

sentenceIntentions.text: But Elias has a failing heart, and medical care points toward a future he must question.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Connect Elias's illness to an uncertain future
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Feel the personal stakes of the promise

sentenceIntentions.text: Mara’s uneven handmade bowl offers a quieter measure of what makes a life singular.
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Notice a tangible alternative measure of singularity

sentenceIntentions.text: Through workshops, clinics, and private conversations, this science-fiction novel brings an uncertain future close to home.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Place the dilemma in workshops and clinics
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Expect embodied scenes rather than abstract futurism

sentenceIntentions.text: Can preserving someone’s likeness preserve the relationship, or change what love asks of the living?
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Open the tension between resemblance and relationship
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Wonder what love asks when likeness can be preserved

sentenceIntentions.text: Enter Mara’s workshop, where the things worth keeping are not always the easiest to reproduce.
sentenceIntentions.purpose: Return to the workshop's imperfect objects
sentenceIntentions.viewerResponse: Want to meet Mara before deciding what counts as preservation
